0.long_answer: The treatment is intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG). This therapy uses a pooled mixture of antibodies derived from multiple healthy donors, and it is applied in several immunologically mediated conditions, including post-transfusion purpura. IVIG helps modulate the immune system by neutralizing pathogenic antibodies and providing anti-inflammatory effects, making it a useful treatment in various autoimmune and immune-mediated diseases.
